acks.detail: The integrated page rendering both Task 1's `#clearCompleted` button and Task 2's `#doneCount` span together (client/src/App.tsx, client/src/TopBar.tsx, client/src/TodoList.tsx, client/src/DoneCount.tsx, client/src/ClearCompleted.tsx) — Both exam records are pass `-0` and were written before the fold: `<runDir>/state-exams/task-1/clear-completed-0/dom.html` contains `clearCompleted` and no `doneCount`, and `<runDir>/state-exams/task-2/done-count-0/dom.html` contains `doneCount` and no `clearCompleted`, so each render move ran on its own task's isolated worktree. Both walls.json read `"render": "ran"` and both store-diff.json are empty, so each half is proven on its own tree; the combined document has never been bundled and POSTed to the renderer, which needs TINYAPP_RENDER_URL and ULTRA_RUN_DIR and a network call this read-only role does not make. Static reading shows no interaction between the two — the button is a sibling of `#todoList` inside `Main`, the span is between `<Title />` and `<Info />` in `#topBar`, and both sit under the one lifted `<Provider>` — and no view entry of either exam or of the fixture's own two exams counts an element the other task adds.

A user's actual press of the `#clearCompleted` button (client/src/ClearCompleted.tsx) — Task 1's Claim is about pressing the button, but no test dispatches a DOM click: the chain is the exam's headless `clearCompleted(store)` call plus M4's greps proving the button carries `onClick=`, `useStore(STORE_ID)` and `clearCompleted(` — a shape the contract pre-registers, and the render move only proves the button is on the page with the right id and text. The click-to-callback edge is verified by reading `client/src/ClearCompleted.tsx:7-14` (the handler guards on `store` and calls the one storeData callback), not by execution; this environment starts no browser to fire the event.
